docs.title: Architecture Overview
docs.text:
Relicbound is split into two main modules:

  • relicbound-core: platform-agnostic logic, models and services (spell catalog, mana service, repositories).
  • relicbound-paper: Paper (Minecraft) adapter, event listeners, and PaperSpellEngine which executes spells.

Key concepts:

  • CoreContext: central record that wires services and repositories into DefaultRelicboundCore.
  • PlayerArchetype: WAND and STAFF archetypes with distinct multipliers for cast speed, damage and mana drain.
  • ManaService / PlayerManaStateRepository: manage player mana states and persist to YAML (data/mana/{uuid}.yml).
  • SpellDefinition and DefaultSpellCatalog: spells are registered centrally with manaCost and manaPerSecond metadata used by the engine and the resource-pack generator.
  • PaperSpellEngine: casting, channeling, cooldowns, and archetype scaling happen here.

Resource-pack generation: tools/generate-resource-pack.ps1 reads DefaultSpellCatalog registrations and writes resource-pack/manifest.json and model overrides under resource-pack/assets/relicbound.

docs.title: Branding & Assets
docs.text:
This folder contains the official Relicbound branding assets and a short style guide.

  • Logo: assets/branding/logo.svg (vector). Use this for headers and converted PNGs for server icons.
  • Colors:
  • Primary: #6A1B9A (deep purple)
  • Accent: #FFB74D (warm amber)
  • Background: #0F1720 (dark slate)

Usage: - Include logo.svg inside the resource-pack at resource-pack/assets/relicbound/textures/branding/logo.svg if you want an in-pack icon. - For server listing banners, export logo.svg to PNG at 128x128 and 512x128.

If you want a custom, hand-drawn logo, replace assets/branding/logo.svg and the copy in the resource-pack.

docs.title: Developer Guide
docs.text:
How to add a new spell and regenerate the resource-pack.

  1. Open relicbound-core/src/main/java/.../catalog/DefaultSpellCatalog.java and call register(...) with a new SpellDefinition.

  2. Set appropriate manaCost and manaPerSecond values and MaterialBinding custom model data.

  3. Rebuild the project:

./gradlew :relicbound-core:build :relicbound-paper:build
  1. Regenerate the resource pack (PowerShell):
Set-Location 'c:\Users\Aaryadev\Desktop\Relicbound SMP'
.\tools\generate-resource-pack.ps1
  1. Test in-game. If the spell needs engine logic (new SpellEffectType), add handling inside PaperSpellEngine.

Notes: - The generator parses DefaultSpellCatalog registration lines; keep the registration format consistent. - resource-pack/manifest.json is the authoritative list used by the docs generator.

docs.title: Quickstart
docs.text:
This guide helps server admins install the Relicbound plugin and resource-pack.

  1. Build the plugin with Gradle:
./gradlew :relicbound-paper:build

  1. Drop the generated JAR into your Paper server plugins/ folder.

  2. Install the resource-pack generated in resource-pack/ or host it and set server.properties resource-pack URL.

To regenerate the resource pack locally:

Windows PowerShell (from repository root):

Set-Location 'c:\Users\Aaryadev\Desktop\Relicbound SMP'
.\tools\generate-resource-pack.ps1
  1. Start the server and test: join the server, choose an archetype (WAND or STAFF), and open the spell menu.

docs.title: Minecraft Cod SMP Full Spell Ability List
docs.text: This reference reflects the current live spell engine and catalog. Where a spell has explicit wand/staff behavior, that difference is noted. Where the engine currently uses shared scaling instead of a separate branch, the spell is described by its actual runtime effect.

docs.title: Ember Burst
docs.text: School: Fire Type: Offensive cone spell Description: Ember Burst releases a cone of flame in front of the caster. Enemies caught inside take damage and ignite. Wand Version: Smaller cone, lower damage, shorter burn. Staff Version: Wider cone, higher damage, longer burn.

docs.title: Phoenix Dash
docs.text: School: Fire Type: Mobility spell Description: Phoenix Dash launches the caster forward in a burst of fire energy for quick engages or escapes. Wand Version: Shorter dash and lower mana pressure. Staff Version: Longer dash with stronger fire-themed mobility.

docs.title: Tide Salve
docs.text: School: Water Type: Healing spell Description: Tide Salve restores health, applies regeneration, removes weak burn effects, and clears short poison or wither pressure. Wand Version: Faster, lighter heal. Staff Version: Stronger healing and broader support impact.

docs.title: Undertow Wave
docs.text: School: Water Type: Crowd control spell Description: Undertow Wave releases a heavy surge that knocks enemies backward and creates space. Wand Version: Smaller push zone. Staff Version: Stronger knockback and larger area.

docs.title: Thunder Lance
docs.text: School: Storm Type: Targeted strike spell Description: Thunder Lance calls lightning onto the nearest target and can chain into nearby enemies. Wand Version: Lower burst and shorter chain pressure. Staff Version: Higher damage with more chain potential.

docs.title: Tempest Chain
docs.text: School: Storm Type: Chain lightning spell Description: Tempest Chain jumps storm energy between grouped enemies. Wand Version: Fewer jumps. Staff Version: More jumps, larger reach, and stronger damage.

docs.title: Lightning Charges
docs.text: School: Storm Type: Storm barrage spell Description: Lightning Charges creates a sequence of rapid lightning hits. Wand use fires a short burst of fixed strikes; staff use turns it into a roaming storm of random strikes. Wand Version: 4 rapid blasts, 20 mana each, 1 heart damage, about 1.5 second stun. Staff Version: 10 to 15 random strikes, 1 heart damage each, longer stun, more battlefield control.

docs.title: Gravity Snare
docs.text: School: Void Type: Channelled crowd control spell Description: Gravity Snare creates a void field that pulls nearby enemies inward while the spell remains active. Wand Version: Smaller pull field and lighter mana pressure. Staff Version: Stronger pull, larger radius, heavier sustain cost.

docs.title: Rift Step
docs.text: School: Void Type: Teleportation spell Description: Rift Step tears open space and moves the caster to a nearby location. Wand Version: Shorter teleport range. Staff Version: Longer repositioning distance.

docs.title: Dawn Aegis
docs.text: School: Light Type: Defensive shield spell Description: Dawn Aegis surrounds the caster in radiant protection and sustains a defensive buff over time. Wand Version: Smaller sustain footprint. Staff Version: Stronger protection and larger aura support.

docs.title: Sanctify
docs.text: School: Light Type: Purification spell Description: Sanctify clears harmful darkness effects and restores nearby allies through holy energy. Wand Version: Faster cast and lighter healing. Staff Version: Wider cleanse radius and stronger healing.

docs.title: Root Bind
docs.text: School: Nature Type: Immobilization spell Description: Root Bind traps enemies in magical roots and, in the current engine, applies extreme Slowness so targets cannot move. Wand Version: Smaller bind area. Staff Version: Stronger root pressure and wider area.

docs.title: Bloom Mend
docs.text: School: Nature Type: Healing spell Description: Bloom Mend restores health with regenerative nature energy. Wand Version: Faster activation with lighter healing. Staff Version: Greater healing and broader ally coverage.

docs.title: Seismic Line
docs.text: School: Stone Type: Ground shock spell Description: Seismic Line releases a crushing shockburst around the caster that knocks enemies back and deals damage. Wand Version: Smaller impact zone. Staff Version: Larger impact zone and heavier push.

docs.title: Bulwark Wall
docs.text: School: Stone Type: Defensive barrier spell Description: Bulwark Wall reinforces the caster with resistance and triggers a stone-flavored knockback burst. The current engine emphasizes defensive control more than a literal placed wall. Wand Version: Lower sustain pressure. Staff Version: Stronger defensive control and greater mana drain.

docs.title: Starfall
docs.text: School: Celestial Type: Burst celestial spell Description: Starfall smites the nearest target with heavenly lightning and glowing impact. Wand Version: Lower damage, faster cooldown. Staff Version: Higher damage and a stronger impact zone.

docs.title: Astral Beacon
docs.text: School: Celestial Type: Support utility spell Description: Astral Beacon surrounds nearby allies with speed, strength, and healing while also restoring the caster. Wand Version: Lower sustain drain and smaller field. Staff Version: Larger support field and stronger utility.

docs.title: Meteor Surge
docs.text: School: Celestial Type: Burst meteor spell Description: Meteor Surge calls down multiple meteors in a concentrated blast. Wand Version: More meteors, broader spread, lighter impact. Staff Version: Fewer meteors, tighter spread, stronger hits.

docs.title: Meteor Rain
docs.text: School: Celestial Type: Area artillery spell Description: Meteor Rain summons several meteors from the sky, each dealing armor-ignoring impact damage in a wide area. Wand Version: More meteors with broader coverage. Staff Version: Fewer meteors, but stronger impacts and a tighter strike pattern.

docs.title: Rewind Step
docs.text: School: Time Type: Temporal recovery spell Description: Rewind Step snaps the caster back toward a safer previous position after a short delay and restores a bit of health. Wand Version: Shorter rewind range. Staff Version: Stronger recovery and repositioning value.

docs.title: Slow Field
docs.text: School: Time Type: Area debuff spell Description: Slow Field heavily reduces enemy movement and combat speed in the target area while applying pressure over time. Wand Version: Smaller area. Staff Version: Larger distortion zone and stronger crowd control.

docs.title: Veil Strike
docs.text: School: Shadow Type: Burst ambush spell Description: Veil Strike lashes nearby enemies with shadow energy and blinds them after the hit.

docs.title: Umbra Walk
docs.text: School: Shadow Type: Stealth spell Description: Umbra Walk cloaks the caster in darkness, adding invisibility, speed, and darkened visual pressure for escape or repositioning.

docs.title: Rally Chant
docs.text: School: Support Type: Buff aura spell Description: Rally Chant now gives the caster and nearby trusted allies speed, strength, resistance, and immediate healing. It is much stronger than the original version and is meant for team fights. Wand Version: Faster support setup with lower sustain cost. Staff Version: Stronger buffs and bigger teamfight value.

docs.title: Life Tether
docs.text: School: Support Type: Healing link spell Description: Life Tether shares healing with nearby allies through a continuous support effect. Wand Version: Lower sustain cost. Staff Version: Stronger healing share and broader support potential.

docs.title: Coin Blessing
docs.text: School: Economy Type: Utility spell Description: Coin Blessing boosts luck and economic outcomes. It also now grants Hero of the Village for 5 minutes.

docs.title: Trail Reveal
docs.text: School: Exploration Type: Tracking spell Description: Trail Reveal gives the caster Night Vision and highlights other players within 180 blocks with Glowing, except trusted players.

docs.title: Sky Leap
docs.text: School: Mobility Type: Movement spell Description: Sky Leap launches the caster upward and forward with much stronger propulsion than the original baseline.

docs.title: Temper Touch
docs.text: School: Crafting Type: Enhancement spell Description: Temper Touch improves tools or equipment for a limited duration and adds crafting speed support.

docs.title: Echo Call
docs.text: School: Summoner Type: Summon spell Description: Echo Call summons a spectral helper. The engine prefers an Allay-style helper and falls back to a wolf ally if needed.

docs.title: Blight Wave
docs.text: School: Corruption Type: Decay spell Description: Blight Wave spreads poison and wither pressure outward in a damaging burst.

docs.title: Abyss Rift
docs.text: School: Corruption Type: Void destruction spell Description: Abyss Rift tears open a dangerous breach of corruption and void energy.

docs.title: Withering Cripple
docs.text: School: Corruption Type: Channelled curse spell Description: Withering Cripple continuously applies Darkness II, Slowness II, and Wither. The curse stays active until the caster stops channeling or runs out of mana. Wand Version: 10 mana drained per second and weaker wither pressure. Staff Version: 20 mana drained per second with full Wither V-style pressure and wider area.

docs.title: Lifedrain
docs.text: School: Corruption Type: Combat sustain spell Description: After activation, critical hits siphon hearts from enemies. Up to 3 hearts can be stolen, and the stolen health persists for a short duration before fading.

docs.title: Malfunction
docs.text: School: Utility Type: Inventory disruption spell Description: Malfunction scrambles a target's inventory to create confusion and mistakes. Wand Version: Shuffles the hotbar and offhand. Staff Version: Shuffles the full inventory and offhand.

docs.title: Frostbite
docs.text: School: Elemental Type: Freeze spell Description: Frostbite freezes enemies and converts nearby water and terrain into ice.

docs.title: Cooker
docs.text: School: Elemental Type: Burning area spell Description: Cooker ignites enemies in a nearby radius and applies continuous fire pressure.

docs.title: Gourmet
docs.text: School: Elemental Type: Consumption buff spell Description: Gourmet consumes a nearby mob and grants a temporary buff based on the mob type consumed.

docs.title: Core Development
docs.text:
The relicbound-core module contains the game logic, registries, and progression systems. Key classes:

  • CoreContext — central context for core services
  • RelicRegistry — registry for relic definitions
  • PlayerRelicStateRepository — player state storage

Run unit tests with ./gradlew :relicbound-core:test.

docs.title: Paper Module
docs.text:
The relicbound-paper module contains the Bukkit/Paper integration (listeners, menu, tasks).

Useful entry points:

  • ArchetypeSelectionListener — handles archetype selection UI
  • ManaRegenTask — periodic mana regeneration logic

Build the paper plugin with ./gradlew :relicbound-paper:build.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
1. Install Java 17 or newer.
  2. Build with Gradle: ./gradlew build.
  3. Copy the generated plugin JAR from relicbound-paper/build/libs into your server's plugins/ folder.

For detailed build options see [Development -> Core].

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
• Configure relicbound-paper/src/main/resources/config.yml as needed.
  • Start your Paper server and verify the plugin loads.
  • Use in-game commands and follow the in-game help for archetype selection.
